prompt:
Design and implement a Rust crate called cesarops-forge â€” an autonomous developer agent that orchestrates the CesarOps cluster for code generation tasks.

WHAT IT DOES (you just watched this happen manually):
1. Reads a task from a tasks.md file
2. Searches nautivecs (POST http://localhost:5003/query) for relevant code context (golden style guide)
3. Fires the task prompt at the 35B Coder (POST http://100.72.182.77:5001/api/v1/generate)
4. Fires the output at the 8B Reviewer (POST http://100.102.158.111:5555/api/v1/generate) for bug review
5. If reviewer finds bugs: feeds corrections back to the 35B with the review as context
6. Runs cargo check on the output â€” if fails, feeds compiler errors back to 35B
7. If passes: writes files to disk, marks task complete, moves to next task
8. Loops until all tasks are done or max_retries (3) hit

CLUSTER ENDPOINTS:
- 35B Coder: http://100.72.182.77:5001/api/v1/generate (KoboldCPP, Qwen3.6-35B MoE)
- 8B Reviewer: http://100.102.158.111:5555/api/v1/generate (KoboldCPP, DeepSeek-R1-8B)
- nautivecs: http://100.72.182.77:5003/query (vector search, 12606 chunks)
- cesarops-wso: http://100.72.182.77:5010/search (web search for cutting-edge answers)

API FORMAT (both LLMs use same KoboldCPP API):
POST /api/v1/generate
Body: {"prompt": "...", "max_length": 8192, "temperature": 0.2}
Response: {"results": [{"text": "...generated code..."}]}

NAUTIVECS API:
POST /query
Body: {"query": "search terms", "top_k": 5}
Response: {"results": [{"content": "...", "score": 0.9, "path": "file.rs"}]}

ARCHITECTURE:
- Single binary, CLI interface
- tokio async runtime
- Reads tasks from a markdown file (checkbox format)
- Each task goes through: Research -> Implement -> Review -> Fix -> Validate -> Deploy
- Expandable: later will orchestrate curvelet processing, scan pipelines, not just code gen

CRATE STRUCTURE:
cesarops-forge/
  Cargo.toml
  src/
    main.rs        â€” CLI entry, tokio runtime, task loop
    llm.rs         â€” KoboldCPP client (generic, works for both 35B and 8B)
    search.rs      â€” nautivecs client + wso client
    tools.rs       â€” write_file, cargo_check (capture stdout/stderr), read_file
    context.rs     â€” builds prompts with injected context from nautivecs
    loop.rs        â€” the agentic loop: reason -> act -> observe -> correct
    tasks.rs       â€” parses tasks.md, tracks completion state

DEPENDENCIES: reqwest, tokio (full), serde, serde_json, tracing, tracing-subscriber, clap (for CLI args), regex (for parsing task checkboxes)

CLI USAGE:
  cesarops-forge --tasks .kiro/specs/warp-grid/tasks.md --target-dir warp-grid/
  cesarops-forge --task 5 --retry  (re-run a specific task)
  cesarops-forge --status  (show which tasks are done)

CONSTRAINTS:
- No trait objects for async â€” use enum dispatch
- All HTTP calls use reqwest with timeout (60s for LLM, 5s for search)
- Borrow-before-move pattern
- tracing for all logging
- If 35B returns empty (context overflow), automatically shorten the prompt and retry
- If 8B review is empty (context overflow), skip review and go straight to cargo check
- Max 3 correction rounds per task before marking as FAILED and moving on

OUTPUT: Complete implementation of all 7 source files. Must pass cargo check.
